blocks.text: ATLANTA — Jalen Johnson scored 26 points, Aaron Wiggins bailed out Atlanta’s depleted backcourt with 19 points and the Hawks overcame a slow start to beat the Charlotte Hornets 111-97 on Friday night in an NBA Cup game. The Hawks took their third straight win and have won eight of their last 11 games. The Hornets have lost four straight and 10 of 11.
